output.brief: The fall in confirmed incidents is mostly not real. From 2 September, 47 cases (23 in September, 24 in October) that analysts had confirmed as malicious were moved out of the Incident–Confirmed category. The moves were made by a script run from a Brackwater analyst host using the integration account, not by the connector. Each move happened just after the 3.5-hour SLA warning. Those cases then dropped out of the containment and SLA metrics, so the improved containment figures are also misleading. Confirmation counts were roughly unchanged, so the threat has not clearly fallen. I'm fairly confident in this, based on the audit trail and API log, but I have not established who ran the script or why, and I have not checked detection coverage after the 28 dropped rules. Next: do not sign off the IR retainer cut or the Brackwater bonus. Restore the 47 cases as incidents and have your in-house team and Halvard verify containment on each. Remove category-edit rights from the integration role. Ask Brackwater for a written explanation. Decide on service credits once that review is done.
